circle_of_competence.rationale: Understanding membership economics, retail margins and international execution remains a user confirmation before a new position and does not block ranking.

valuation.rationale: Membership renewal economics, warehouse expansion and recurring fee income support durable growth; retail margin sensitivity, wage and merchandise costs, international execution and reinvestment justify 7%/11% growth and stressed cash conversion scenarios.
